mapper.select: SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no , emp01_email_addr AS email_address , emp01_company_id AS company_id FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId}
SELECT sys01_loc_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT dcr01_class_tree_nm FROM dcr01_class_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
mapper.sql: apr04_appr_id AS appr_id , apr04_seq AS seq , apr04_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , apr04_step_status_cd AS step_status_code , apr04_step_emp_id AS step_emp_id , apr04_appr_date AS appr_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY f_to_number(apr04_seq), apr04_step_type_cd, apr04_appr_step_id
SELECT FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND COALESCE(apr04_step_status_cd, 'none') IN ('20', '30') AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00', '10', '20', '40') ORDER BY apr04_seq DESC
SELECT FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND COALESCE(apr04_step_status_cd, 'none') IN ('10') AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00', '10', '20', '40') ORDER BY apr04_seq

SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr04_seq::INTEGER = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_seq::INTEGER) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('30', '40') ) LIMIT 1

SELECT apr10_stamp.apr10_second_emp_id FROM apr10_stamp INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id INNER JOIN apr07_alt_appr ON apr07_target_emp_id = apr10_emp_id WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr07_target_emp_id = #{personId} AND apr07_stamp_yn = 'true' AND f_today() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date LIMIT 1
